name: My Doctor is a Futanari
source:
Frequent headaches are starting to get in the way of you everyday life.
You find a Doctor online, set an appointment and give her a visit.
Things take an unsuspected turn however, when a simple checkup turns intimate.

Will your new GP be able to resolve your qualms?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1854140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
频繁的头痛开始影响你的日常生活。
你在线找到一位医生，预约并拜访她。
然而，当一次简单的检查变得亲密时，事情发生了意想不到的转变。

你的新全科医生能够解决你的疑虑吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1854140/]Steam[/url]]
